description: Measures how many participating branches are explicitly documented by authentic bank source promotion text.
populationDefinition: Total ground-truth participating branch venues expected by promotion terms (60 branches across 25 promotions).
findings: 22 of 25 bank promotions provide explicit participating branch outlet lists in HTML or general terms. 3 promotions state "Selected Outlets apply" without publishing any list in page text, for which zero pins are safely generated.
